    components = remaining.split('/')
    
    link_count = 0
    max_links = 8

        # Skip empty components and '.'
        if component == '' or component == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Handle '..'
        if component == '..':
            if current != '/':
                # Move to parent directory
                current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                if current == '':
                    current = '/'
            i += 1
            continue

        if current == '/':
            next_path = '/' + component
        else:
            next_path = current + '/' + component

        if next_path in links:
            link_count += 1
            if link_count > max_links:
                return None
            
            target = links[next_path]
            
            # Resolve the target relative to the directory containing the link
            if target.startswith('/'):
                # Absolute target
                current = '/'
                remaining_from_target = target[1:]

                # Relative target - relative to the directory containing the link

                if current == '':

            target_components = remaining_from_target.split('/')
            components = target_components + components[i+1:]
            i = 0
            continue
        
        current = next_path
        i += 1
    
    # Remove trailing slash (except for '/')
    if current != '/' and current.endswith('/'):
        current = current.rstrip('/')
    
    return current
